title: CFA Zero Lost Days Safety Award Recognition
summary: Recognized by the Central Fabricators Association for achieving zero lost days due to workplace injury across 2014.

detail.lead: In 2014, Sioux City Foundry Co. earned the Central Fabricators Association Zero Lost Days Safety Award.
body: Safety across foundry pouring floors, crane bays, laser tables, and rebar yards starts with daily shop-floor discipline and clear operating procedures.
This 2014 recognition remains a proud milestone in the company's public awards archive.
highlights: Zero lost days due to workplace injury in 2014
Part of SCF's public safety and recognition record

title: Serving Siouxland & the Midwest Since November 1871
summary: From a corner shop at Main and Seventh in Sioux City to two modern campuses across Iowa and Nebraska.

detail.lead: Sioux City Foundry Co. was founded in November 1871 on the corner of Main and Seventh streets in Sioux City, Iowa.
body: Across more than 150 years of family ownership, the company grew into a regional One-Stop Metal Shop operating Plant 1 in Sioux City, Iowa, and Plant 2 in South Sioux City, Nebraska.

Today four active divisions serve contractors, OEMs, agricultural equipment makers, and builders: Steel Service Center, Reinforcing Steel, Contract Manufacturing, and our Gray and Ductile Iron Foundry.
highlights: Founded November 1871 in Sioux City, Iowa
Two plants serving Iowa, Nebraska, and the broader Midwest
